description: We’re taking on a health challenge with MedAR, an augmented reality interface for astronauts. It tracks your hand live and overlays step-by-step guidance for medical procedures, like showing exactly where to make an incision using a standard med kit. It also turns a daily strain score into an AR exercise game, so if a crew member hasn’t been active enough, they fly through virtual hoops to hit their target. We already have a working prototype with hand tracking, live vitals and the strain game.
